# PUT and DELETE endpoints: update and remove a stored item

- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** feature (thin slice; the emitter's remaining verbs)
- **Milestone:** Usable v1 (shortest path to a real prototype)
- **Source:** Steve's direction relayed by Dispatch, 2026-10-27 (let's get to a real prototype first) and Decider D86 (Codex No with fixes that were adopted, Grok Support-it): the shortest path to a real multi-endpoint app written in Phrase that compiles, builds, passes its generated specs and runs. Replaces the dependency chain of cards 008 to 012 and 057, which pulled in the base-library line and a deferred rule card.
- **Depends on:** 131
- **Story:** As Dana, I want PUT and DELETE endpoints that update and remove a stored item, so that I can describe a complete small CRUD service.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given PUT /items/{id}, When its specs run, Then a known id updates and responds with the new record, an unknown id fails with NotFound, and an invalid body fails with its declared validation code, all passing
  2. Given DELETE /items/{id}, When its specs run, Then a known id removes the item (a later GET fails with NotFound) and an unknown id fails with NotFound
  3. Given the other endpoints, When this card is merged, Then the earlier endpoint tests and orders.phrase stay green
